lines: Senzaki was known as the most crime-ridden city in the capital region.
Once upon a time, it had been a commuter town for Tokyo, but due to an influx of war refugees, the city centre had turned into a slum.
Furthermore, residents of Hell and criminal organizations had gathered there, and completed its transformation into a giant underworld entertainment district.
Moreover, because it had a traditional trade port, it served as a strategically important base for the various underworld powers, and violent clashes occurred on a daily basis.
It was a dangerous town, where one couldn't get through even a day safely without both luck and ability.
And a woman was walking through that city, on her own.
It was a woman with a short haircut.
Her age was probably somewhere around her mid-twenties.
Highly revealing clothing, and spectacular proportions underneath it.
That didn't exactly avoid coming across as the kind of woman most often found in Senzaki: a prostitute.
However, this woman was different.
The reason she wasn't attracting attention, dressed like that, was because she was masking her presence quite naturally.
Also, for some reason, she was covering her face, which seemed like that of a real beauty, with a black eye mask.
Whether she was blind, or she had some other reason for it, either way, there was nothing unnatural about her stride.
Despite covering both eyes, the woman walked Senzaki at night on her own, as if she could see.
She went by the name of Yuri.
Yuri
Her lips suddenly screwed up.
She came to a halt, and pressed gently on her eyes through her blindfold.
Her hand was trembling, as though she were braving something.
Yuri
「......Looks like there's not much time.」
Yuri muttered, then took her hand off her eye mask and set off walking again.
And then, without being noticed by anyone, she disappeared into the Senzaki crowd.
Roughly an hour later―――
Yuri had moved away from the downtown streets, and arrived at a certain mansion in the harbour district.
That place used to be the estate of an old wealthy man who was well-known in Senzaki.
“Used to,” because that rich old man was no longer there.
A different person had settled in there now.
Which was why Yuri had come along.
Yuri the assassin.
Yuri
She was hiding herself in a garden bush, peering stealthily at the state of the mansion.
Her eye mask was still on. She was “watching” through it.
The number of guards was seven at the moment.
Four of them outside the estate, patrolling along the walls in pairs.
Three of them inside the walls, surrounding the mansion.
Perhaps because it was the new master's preference, all of them were women.
They were all carrying guns, but none of them, including the four prowling outside the walls, were concentrating on guarding.
That was because, a few days ago, the bosses who controlled the harbour had dispatched a considerable number of soldiers here, and they had had the tables absolutely turned on them.
It was like the guards weren't taking things seriously, thinking that there would be no follow-up attack, and even if there were, their master would handle it.
The woman standing in front of the main entrance, for instance, was currently yawning like she was bored.
Yuri
（In this case, there's no need to use my eyes. Let's just sneak in normally.）
Yuri soundlessly emerged from the bushes, then swiftly approached the mansion, slipping past the eyes of the useless guards.
Yuri
In contrast to the security outside, which was at least rigorous in terms of numbers, the inside was completely deserted.
She didn't sense any sign of people.
Yuri
（But you are here, aren't you......?）
The back of her neck tingled.
What she could faintly sense was miasma.
Something akin to a scent, which Yuri was able to detect precisely because of who she was—precisely because she was a former Taimanin.
It was something that brought the Demon World to mind.
Yuri
（And, they've noticed me.）
She was warned by her intuition, which had long gotten her through life-or-death situations as an assassin.
Yuri
Yuri quietly drew the kodachi she had concealed on her left and right forearms.
That moment―――
The miasma, which had previously been all but non-existent, surged.
Yuri
（Sorcery!!）
She spun around due to that sign of something being cast.
A magic circle had appeared atop the floor, and from there, a monster appeared.
Otherworld Golem
「GYYYYYYYYY!!」
A giant gave a piercing screech, like creaking metal.
It was an Otherworld golem.
And from behind it, the master of the mansion gracefully showed herself.
Witch
「Looks like you have a good nose, for a bunch of hoodlums' henchman♪」
Lifeless skin which gave the impression of a corpse.
Yet at the same time, a radiant allure.
It was a witch.

Though she was originally the kept woman of the wealthy old man, she had taken advantage of his loneliness to inflict a deadly curse under the pretence of illness, and skillfully taken over both his mansion and
his assets.
Not only that, but she had antagonized the underworld powers who controlled the harbour, which was the main reason Yuri had been sent after her.
Yuri
Yuri readied her short swords in silence.
Seeing that, the witch chuckled.
Witch
「Ever since that recent attack, there's been so little excitement, I was getting bored. Golem, play around with her awhile.」
Otherworld Golem
「GUGAAAAAAAAAAA!!」
She gave a captivating wave of her hand, whereupon the golem approached, making the ground shake.
